entwurf.beschreibung: Discover the Milwaukee Brewers history from their 1969 Seattle Pilots origins to a record‑setting 103 win season.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: The Brewers hit 103 wins in 2026, ending decades of longing.
teile.szene: A modern Milwaukee skyline at dusk. A baseball field lights up. A cheering crowd fills the stands. The team logo glows. Fans raise flags.

teile.name: Origins
teile.text: They began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969 before bankruptcy moved them.
teile.szene: A 1969 Seattle harbor at sunset. A baseball field in the background. Players in blue uniforms practice under a gray sky. A newspaper headline reads ‘Pilots’.

teile.name: Relocation
teile.suche: Bud Selig acquisition, Milwaukee Brewers relocation
teile.text: The team was acquired in bankruptcy court by Bud Selig and relocated to Milwaukee.
teile.szene: A courtroom scene in 1970. A judge speaks. A baseball logo is transferred across a city map from Seattle to Milwaukee. Fans cheer outside the courthouse.
teile.bildtext: Selig moving the team to Milwaukee

teile.name: First Success
teile.suche: 1981 AL East champions, Rollie Fingers MVP
teile.text: In 1981 they won the AL East, with Rollie Fingers earning MVP.
teile.szene: A 1981 baseball stadium at night. Players in orange uniforms celebrate a win. Rollie Fingers throws a baseball to a teammate. Fans wave banners.

teile.name: World Series
teile.text: The 1982 squad, led by Robin Yount, reached the World Series but fell.
teile.szene: A 1982 night game. Players in white uniforms sprint across the field. Yount hits a home run. The scoreboard shows 4‑3. Fans watch tense.

teile.name: League Switch
teile.text: They switched to the National League in 1998 and reached the playoffs in 2008.
teile.szene: A 1998 baseball field. The Brewers logo changes from AL to NL. A 2008 playoff banner hangs. Players stretch, ready for game.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: A digital interface with like, share, save icons glowing. A cursor clicks each button. The background shows a cheering crowd.
